Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. Two establishments retained, both read at source. First, the Ernst Busch drama school in Berlin, puppetry department, a four-year course awarding a diploma in puppetry and performing arts, founded in 1971-72. Second, the state academy of music and performing arts in Stuttgart, whose figure theatre programme was created in 1983 and is awarded at bachelor level only, in an institution explicitly state-run and funded by Baden-Wurttemberg. The German source states Stuttgart is the only conservatoire in the country offering figure theatre, which does not contradict Berlin, a drama school rather than a music school: both count. Upper bound held at 2: both courses are documented and no third appears, training in Germany being otherwise largely carried by private bodies outside the denominator.

establishments.name: Hochschule für Schauspielkunst «Ernst Busch», Abteilung Puppenspielkunst
establishments.award: Diploma in puppetry / performing arts, 4 years
establishments.description: The puppetry department of the Ernst Busch drama school, founded 1971-72 in East Berlin and still the reference training in the German-speaking world. Moved to the Zinnowitzer Straße campus in 2018.

establishments.name: Staatliche Hochschule für Musik und Darstellende Kunst, Studiengang Figurentheater
establishments.award: Bachelor of Arts in figure theatre, offered at bachelor level only
establishments.description: The figure theatre programme was created in 1983 and remains the only one of its kind at a German conservatoire. The school is state-run, funded by the state of Baden-Württemberg.

establishments.name: Figurentheater-Kolleg
establishments.award: Eight-semester professional training, outside state higher education
establishments.description: A long-established private college for puppet, material and object theatre. Recorded here because it is often mistaken for a state school, including by search engines answering queries about Austria.
